brief.topic: Sahih al-Bukhari 6094: truthfulness leads to righteousness
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Sahih al-Bukhari 6094 describes truthfulness as a path that leads to righteousness; it is built in small, everyday honesty.

hooks.text: Would you notice a small lie?

selectionRationale: Most relevant and gentle; invites a check-in without guilt.

scenes.onScreen: Honesty starts in small things. / A daily check-in.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.
scenes.excerpt: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And a man keeps on telling the truth until he becomes a truthful person

scenes.onScreen: CHECK-IN / Did I exaggerate to make a story better? · Did I keep my word, or make an excuse? · Did I admit it when I didn't know? · Was I honest about my own mistake? · Was I truthful when no one would notice?
items: Did I exaggerate to make a story better?
Did I keep my word, or make an excuse?
Did I admit it when I didn't know?
Was I honest about my own mistake?
Was I truthful when no one would notice?

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / Why it matters / This hadith describes truthfulness as a path: each honest word is a step along it. Small honesty, repeated, is how the path is walked.
body: This hadith describes truthfulness as a path: each honest word is a step along it.
